lines.raw: The common problems.
lines.say: The common problems.

lines.raw: Here is a quick table.
lines.say: Here is a quick table.

lines.raw: **Duplicate providers**. Example: Same NPI from NPPES and contracting, with different spelling. Fix: Keep **one row per NPI** (per version). Match on NPI, never on name.
lines.say: Duplicate providers. Example: Same N P I from N P P E S and contracting, with different spelling. Fix: Keep one row per N P I (per version). Match on N P I, never on name.

lines.raw: **Invalid NPI**. Example: `1234567890` fails the Luhn check. Fix: Validate every NPI; send failures back for correction instead of creating a new provider.
lines.say: Invalid N P I. Example: 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 0 fails the Luhn check. Fix: Validate every N P I; send failures back for correction instead of creating a new provider.

lines.raw: **Many NPIs per TIN**. Example: Sunrise Family Clinic and Dr. Patel share TIN 74-5550101. Fix: This is **normal**, not a duplicate (lesson 4). Never merge providers just because they share a TIN.
lines.say: Many N P I's per T I N. Example: Sunrise Family Clinic and Doctor Patel share T I N 74-5550101. Fix: This is normal, not a duplicate (lesson 4). Never merge providers just because they share a T I N.

lines.raw: **One NPI, several TINs**. Example: A doctor works for two groups. Fix: Also normal: keep one provider and two affiliations.
lines.say: One N P I, several T I N's. Example: A doctor works for two groups. Fix: Also normal: keep one provider and two affiliations.

lines.raw: **Stale addresses**. Example: Sunrise Family Clinic moved on 1 Sep 2025, but one feed still shows the old address. Fix: Choose a trusted source for addresses and verify them regularly. Keep the old address with an end date.
lines.say: Stale addresses. Example: Sunrise Family Clinic moved on 1 Sep 2025, but one feed still shows the old address. Fix: Choose a trusted source for addresses and verify them regularly. Keep the old address with an end date.

lines.raw: **Missing taxonomy**. Example: The contracting feed has no taxonomy for the hospital. Fix: Fill it from NPPES; flag providers still missing a specialty.
lines.say: Missing taxonomy. Example: The contracting feed has no taxonomy for the hospital. Fix: Fill it from N P P E S; flag providers still missing a specialty.

lines.raw: **Several taxonomies**. Example: A doctor lists Family Medicine and Sports Medicine. Fix: Use the one flagged **primary** for specialty reports.
lines.say: Several taxonomies. Example: A doctor lists Family Medicine and Sports Medicine. Fix: Use the one flagged primary for specialty reports.

lines.raw: **Moves between groups**. Example: Dr. Lee leaves Lakeside Surgical Group for another group. Fix: NPI stays the same, but TIN and group change: end the old affiliation and add a new one.
lines.say: Moves between groups. Example: Doctor Lee leaves Lakeside Surgical Group for another group. Fix: N P I stays the same, but T I N and group change: end the old affiliation and add a new one.

lines.raw: **Deactivated NPI**. Example: A retired doctor's NPI is deactivated in NPPES. Fix: Flag claims with service dates after deactivation for review.
lines.say: Deactivated N P I. Example: A retired doctor's N P I is deactivated in N P P E S. Fix: Flag claims with service dates after deactivation for review.

lines.raw: **Missing rendering NPI**. Example: Hospital claim lines with no rendering doctor. Fix: Often normal on hospital claims; keep the lines, do not drop them.
lines.say: Missing rendering N P I. Example: Hospital claim lines with no rendering doctor. Fix: Often normal on hospital claims; keep the lines, do not drop them.

lines.raw: Keep history, do not overwrite.
lines.say: Keep history, do not overwrite.

lines.raw: When Sunrise Family Clinic moved, the easy fix is to **overwrite** the old address.
lines.say: When Sunrise Family Clinic moved, the easy fix is to overwrite the old address.

lines.raw: But then Emily's March 2025 visit would show an address the clinic did not have yet.
lines.say: But then Emily's March 2025 visit would show an address the clinic did not have yet.

lines.raw: The better fix is to **close** the old record with an end date (31 Aug 2025) and **add** a new record from 1 Sep 2025.
lines.say: The better fix is to close the old record with an end date (31 Aug 2025) and add a new record from 1 Sep 2025.

lines.raw: Network status (lesson 5) and affiliations (lesson 4) already work this way.
lines.say: Network status (lesson 5) and affiliations (lesson 4) already work this way.

lines.say: Lesson 8 shows the full table.

lines.raw: What bad provider data breaks.
lines.say: What bad provider data breaks.

lines.raw: A missing or wrong **taxonomy** puts spend under the wrong specialty and breaks **PCP attribution** (lesson 6): if Dr. Lee were stored as Family Medicine, Emily's surgery would count as a primary care visit.
lines.say: A missing or wrong taxonomy puts spend under the wrong specialty and breaks P C P attribution (lesson 6): if Doctor Lee were stored as Family Medicine, Emily's surgery would count as a primary care visit.

lines.raw: A **duplicate** provider splits one hospital's spend in two.
lines.say: A duplicate provider splits one hospital's spend in two.

lines.raw: An **invalid NPI** leaves claims with no provider at all.
lines.say: An invalid N P I leaves claims with no provider at all.

lines.raw: A **stale address** sends members to doctors who are not there: the "ghost network" problem from lesson 1.
lines.say: A stale address sends members to doctors who are not there: the "ghost network" problem from lesson 1.

lines.say: Why it matters for data.

lines.raw: Provider data is shared by every report that touches claims.
lines.say: Provider data is shared by every report that touches claims.

lines.raw: Clean it **once**, in the provider master file, with clear rules: match on NPI, validate with Luhn, pick a trusted source for each field, and keep history with dates.
lines.say: Clean it once, in the provider master file, with clear rules: match on N P I, validate with Luhn, pick a trusted source for each field, and keep history with dates.

lines.raw: Then every analyst gets the same answer.
lines.say: Then every analyst gets the same answer.

lines.raw: Key takeaways.
lines.say: Key takeaways.

lines.raw: Provider feeds disagree: expect duplicates, typos, stale addresses and missing taxonomy.
lines.say: Provider feeds disagree: expect duplicates, typos, stale addresses and missing taxonomy.

lines.raw: Match providers on **NPI**, never on name; validate NPIs with the Luhn check.
lines.say: Match providers on N P I, never on name; validate N P I's with the Luhn check.

lines.raw: Many NPIs per TIN, and one NPI with several TINs, are **normal** relationships, not duplicates.
lines.say: Many N P I's per T I N, and one N P I with several T I N's, are normal relationships, not duplicates.

lines.raw: When details change, **close the old record and add a new one** instead of overwriting.
lines.say: When details change, close the old record and add a new one instead of overwriting.

lines.raw: Bad provider data breaks specialty reports, attribution and network directories.
lines.say: Bad provider data breaks specialty reports, attribution and network directories.
